# GDINA Package for Cognitively Diagnostic Analyses

[![Project Status: Active ? The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Wenchao-Ma/GDINA/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Wenchao-Ma/GDINA/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/GDINA)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GDINA)
[![CRAN monthly
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/GDINA?color=brightgreen)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GDINA)
[![CRAN total
downloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/GDINA?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GDINA)

## How to cite the package

Ma, W. & de la Torre, J. (2020). GDINA: An R Package for Cognitive
Diagnosis Modeling. Journal of Statistical Software, 93(14), 1-26.
<https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v093.i14>

Visit the package website <https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/> for
examples, tutorials and more information.

## Learning resources

- Watch [Ma and de la Torre’s (2019) NCME digital module
  5](https://ncme.elevate.commpartners.com/) on a gentle introduction to
  the G-DINA model framework and the use of graphical user interface for
  CDM analyses

- Check [the book chapter by Ma
  (2019)](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-05584-4_29) on an
  introduction to the GDINA package

- Check [de la Torre and Akbay’s (2019) article](https://ejer.com.tr/)
  on how to conduct various CDM analyses using the graphical user
  interface

- Check [Shi, et al (2021)](https://doi.org/10.3390/psych3040052) on how
  to use this package, along with other R packages for CDM analyses

## Features of the package

- Estimating G-DINA model and a variety of widely-used models subsumed
  by the G-DINA model, including the DINA model, DINO model,
  additive-CDM (A-CDM), linear logistic model (LLM), reduced
  reparametrized unified model (RRUM), multiple-strategy DINA model for
  dichotomous responses
- Estimating models within the G-DINA model framework using
  user-specified design matrix and link functions
- Estimating Bugs-DINA, DINO and G-DINA models for dichotomous responses
- Estimating sequential G-DINA model for ordinal and nominal responses
- Estimating the generalized multiple-strategy cognitive diagnosis
  models (experimental)
- Estimating the diagnostic tree model (experimental)
- Estimating multiple-choice models
- Modelling independent, saturated, higher-order, loglinear smoothed,
  and structured joint attribute distribution
- Accommodating multiple-group model analysis
- Imposing monotonic constrained success probabilities
- Accommodating binary and polytomous attributes
- Validating Q-matrix under the general model framework
- Evaluating absolute and relative item and model fit
- Comparing models at the test and item levels
- Detecting differential item functioning using Wald and likelihood
  ratio test
- Simulating data based on all aforementioned CDMs
- Providing graphical user interface for users less familiar with R

## Installation

The stable version of GDINA should be installed from R CRAN at
[here](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=GDINA)

To install this package from source:

1.  Windows users may need to install the
    [Rtools](https://CRAN.R-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) and include
    the checkbox option of installing Rtools to their path for easier
    command line usage. Mac users will have to download the necessary
    tools from the
    [Xcode](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/xcode/id497799835?mt=12) and
    its related command line tools (found within Xcode’s Preference Pane
    under Downloads/Components); most Linux distributions should already
    have up to date compilers (or if not they can be updated easily).

2.  Install the `devtools` package (if necessary), and install the
    package from the Github source code. Note that the version on Github
    is the development version, which may contain new features and bug
    fixes that are not yet available on CRAN and the API may change.

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Wenchao-Ma/GDINA")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`CA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/CA.md) :
  Calculate classification accuracy
- [`CM()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/CM.md) :
  Calculate Misclassification Matrices
- [`ClassRate()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/ClassRate.md)
  : Classification Rate Evaluation
- [`DTM()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/DTM.md) :
  Diagnostic multiple-strategy CDMs
- [`GDINA-package`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA-package.md)
  : The Generalized DINA Model Framework
- [`GDINA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`anova(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`coef(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`extract(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`personparm(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`logLik(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`deviance(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`nobs(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`vcov(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`npar(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`indlogLik(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`indlogPost(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  [`summary(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GDINA.md)
  : CDM calibration under the G-DINA model framework
- [`GMSCDM()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/GMSCDM.md) :
  Estimating multiple-strategy cognitive diagnosis models
- [`ILCA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/ILCA.md) :
  Iterative latent-class analysis
- [`LC2LG()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/LC2LG.md) :
  Transformation between latent classes and latent groups
- [`MCmodel()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/MCmodel.md)
  : Multiple-choice models
- [`Qval()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/Qval.md)
  [`extract(`*`<Qval>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/Qval.md)
  [`summary(`*`<Qval>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/Qval.md)
  : Q-matrix validation
- [`att.structure()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/att.structure.md)
  : Generate hierarchical attribute structures
- [`attributepattern()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/attributepattern.md)
  : Generate all possible attribute patterns
- [`autoGDINA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/autoGDINA.md)
  [`summary(`*`<autoGDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/autoGDINA.md)
  : Q-matrix validation, model selection and calibration in one run
- [`bdiagMatrix()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/bdiagMatrix.md)
  : Create a block diagonal matrix
- [`bootSE()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/bootSE.md) :
  Calculating standard errors and variance-covariance matrix using
  bootstrap methods
- [`cjoint()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/cjoint.md) :
  Combine R Objects by Columns
- [`designmatrix()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/designmatrix.md)
  : Generate design matrix
- [`dif()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/dif.md)
  [`summary(`*`<dif>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/dif.md)
  : Differential item functioning for cognitive diagnosis models
- [`extract()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/extract.md)
  : extract elements from objects of various classes
- [`indlogLik()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/indlogLik.md)
  : Extract log-likelihood for each individual
- [`indlogPost()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/indlogPost.md)
  : Extract log posterior for each individual
- [`itemfit()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/itemfit.md)
  [`extract(`*`<itemfit>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/itemfit.md)
  [`summary(`*`<itemfit>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/itemfit.md)
  : Item fit statistics
- [`itemfitPD()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/itemfitPD.md)
  : Item fit statistics from the power-divergence family
- [`itemparm()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/itemparm.md)
  : extract item parameters (deprecated)
- [`modelcomp()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/modelcomp.md)
  [`extract(`*`<modelcomp>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/modelcomp.md)
  [`summary(`*`<modelcomp>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/modelcomp.md)
  : Item-level model comparison using Wald, LR or LM tests
- [`modelfit()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/modelfit.md)
  : Model fit statistics
- [`monocheck()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/monocheck.md)
  : This function checks if monotonicity is violated
- [`npar()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/npar.md) :
  Calculate the number of parameters
- [`pairwiseDIF()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/pairwiseDIF.md)
  : Pairwise post hoc DIF analysis
- [`personparm()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/personparm.md)
  : calculate person (incidental) parameters
- [`plot(`*`<GDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/plot.GDINA.md)
  : Create plots for GDINA estimates
- [`plot(`*`<Qval>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/plot.Qval.md)
  : Mesa plot for Q-matrix validation
- [`plot(`*`<itemfit>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/plot.itemfit.md)
  : Item fit plots
- [`plot(`*`<pairwiseDIF>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/plot.pairwiseDIF.md)
  : Grouped bar plots for pairwise DIF posthoc analysis
- [`realdata_ECPE`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/realdata_ECPE.md)
  : Examination for the Certificate of Proficiency in English (ECPE)
  data
- [`realdata_Tatsuoka1990`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/realdata_Tatsuoka1990.md)
  : Tatsuoka's fraction subtraction data
- [`rowMatch()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/rowMatch.md)
  : Count the frequency of a row vector in a data frame
- [`score()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/score.md) :
  Score function
- [`sim10GDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim10GDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (10 items, G-DINA model)
- [`sim10MCDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim10MCDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (10 items, MC-DINA model)
- [`sim10MCDINA2`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim10MCDINA2.md)
  : Simulated data (10 items, MC-DINA model)
- [`sim20seqGDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim20seqGDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (20 items, sequential G-DINA model)
- [`sim21seqDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim21seqDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (21 items, sequential DINA model)
- [`sim30DINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim30DINA.md)
  : Simulated data (30 items, DINA model)
- [`sim30GDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim30GDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (30 items, G-DINA model)
- [`sim30pGDINA`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/sim30pGDINA.md)
  : Simulated data (30 items, polytomous G-DINA model)
- [`simDTM()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/simDTM.md) :
  Simulating data for diagnostic tree model
- [`simGDINA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/simGDINA.md)
  [`extract(`*`<simGDINA>`*`)`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/simGDINA.md)
  : Data simulation based on the G-DINA models
- [`startGDINA()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/startGDINA.md)
  : Graphical user interface of the GDINA function
- [`unique_only()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/unique_only.md)
  : Unique values in a vector
- [`unrestrQ()`](https://wenchao-ma.github.io/GDINA/reference/unrestrQ.md)
  : Generate unrestricted Qc matrix from an restricted Qc matrix
